items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Well, I, having played with Noble Sissle, I'd say, that guy, I don't know how he got into Noble's band.

ctx.x: He had a wonderful funeral. But I had a wonderful souvenir of Mr. Sissle, because Mr. Sissle knew, he was not what you'd call a musician, and he didn't try to say that he was.

And I had heard of certain musicians -- I won't mention the names--- it was recently, who made remarks saying that -- one of them wrote a book even, and he said, Noble Sissle's band was Uncle Tom and that, you see, he said that the music was awful, they was just corny, and --
